author: GamingBolt
description:
In part 13 of our Resident Evil recap, we covered the dramatic events of RE5, but before we subject ourselves to the monstrosity that is Resident Evil 6, here, in part 14 of our full series recap, we are going to talk about the game that serves as a bridge to it- Resident Evil Revelations 2, which also serves as a follow up to RE5 and, of course, the first Revelations. 

Revelations 2 is set in the year 2011, a couple of years after the events of Resident Evil 5 and the death of Albert Wesker, and features two primary playable protagonists- Claire Redfield, who returns for her third outing after RE2 and Code: Veronica, and longtime fan favourite Barry Burton, Chris and Jill’s former STARS comrade who steps into the limelight as a playable character for the first time in a Resident Evil game.
title: Resident Evil Revelations 2 Story - What The HELL Happened?

author: GamingBolt
description:
Resident Evil thrives on tension, through dimly-lit corridors, ammo scarcity, and a rarity of health-restoring herbs. Foreboding is the series’ lifeblood, yet nothing unsettles the balance quite like the franchise’s gauntlet of stalking pursuers. 

These assailants aren’t just boss fights. No, a true Resident Evil pursuer actively hunts you, often unkillable, or effectively so, during its chase phase. Intruding on exploration, they devolve navigation into something disruptive, aggravating, and hostile. 

From early experiments to genre-defining designs, here are Resident Evil’s most notable pursuers, ranked from least to most effective.
title: Resident Evil’s Most Terrifying STALKERS, Ranked From Least To Most Effective

author: GamingBolt
description:
2026 isn’t just about heavy hitting titles from big studios. There are a bunch of cool ideas in play that could catch your attention just as well as the big-budget titles currently in development and eyeing a release either in this year or a little later down the line. 

From a sequel to a fairly well-received 2019 title to a sci-fi adventure that's designed to explore humanity at its most granular levels, there's something for everyone here. And of course, there's Keanu Reeves stepping into the digital avatar of a character he's made quite popular. 

Join us as we take a look at some of the most interesting single player games we're waiting to play either this year or in the near future.
title: 15 Just Announced Single Player Games of 2026 And Beyond
